description: Rules for extracting display fields from hierarchy_path breadcrumbs. All extraction is done from the last element of the breadcrumb (split by ' > ').

fields.short_title: The human-readable title without citation prefix
fields.level_identifier: The identifier at this hierarchy level (e.g., section number)
fields.citation: Full formatted citation for legal reference

example.input: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. Tit. 1 § 22.30 - Basis of classification

short_title.name: nj_admin_no_dash
short_title.condition: last_breadcrumb LIKE 'N.J. Admin%' AND NOT LIKE '% - %'

example.input: N.J. Admin. Code Tit. 7, ch. 26B, app B

short_title.name: ny_comp_no_dash
short_title.condition: last_breadcrumb LIKE 'N.Y. Comp%' AND NOT LIKE '% - %'

example.input: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. tit. 9, Appendices, app S-8

short_title.name: plain_name
short_title.description: Already a plain title (no citation prefix)

level_identifier.name: ny_section_symbol
level_identifier.extract: text between '§ ' and ' - ' (or end if no dash)

example.input: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. Tit. 10 § 154.4 - Village of newark

level_identifier.name: nj_section_symbol
level_identifier.extract: text between '§ ' and ' - ' (the full citation like 8:43D-4.6)

citation.name: ny_section
citation.description: NY section - extract title number and section

example.input: N.Y. Comp. Codes R. & Regs. Tit. 10 § 154.4 - Village

sql_implementation.note: All extraction uses ONLY hierarchy_path - no state-specific fields
